blocks.heading: Basics
lines: Profit % = profit ÷ CP × 100. It is on cost unless the question says otherwise.
Find CP from SP: SP 990 after a 10% loss, CP = 990 ÷ 0.9 = 1,100.

blocks.heading: Markup then discount
lines: Take CP = 100 and apply the multipliers.
Markup 40%, discount 10%: 100 to 140 to 126, so profit 26%.
To earn 20% after a 20% discount: MP = 1.2 ÷ 0.8 = 1.5 times CP.

blocks.heading: Shortcuts
lines: Same SP, one article at +x% and one at -x%: overall loss = x²/100 %. At 20% it is 4%.
SP of m items = CP of n items: profit % = (n - m) ÷ m × 100. 12 and 15 gives 25%.
False weight: profit % = (true - false weight) ÷ false weight × 100. 900 g for 1 kg gives 100 ÷ 900 = 11.11%.
